name: Grok Bot Glass
tagline: Talk to your Grok Bots from your G2.
description: See which of your Grok Bots need you, read their replies, and speak a message to any bot with a long press. Approvals stay in the Grok Bot app. Needs your own Grok Bot Glass relay and a pairing code from your Grok Bot.
author: cmdlabtech

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends your messages to your own Grok Bot Glass relay and loads bot replies and the items that need you.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short voice message while you hold or tap to talk. The audio goes to your relay to be turned into text, and the relay does not keep it.
